findings.finding: LoadMyDeckSDCharacters reads the source collection count, branches directly to the normal epilogue when count is zero, and therefore performs zero LoadCharacter calls. A null source collection follows the throw helper instead, so portable absence must map to an owned empty collection rather than a null engine collection.

The SD intro coroutine rejects a null internal character collection but accepts count zero: its first loop comparison branches to the same fixed 3.0-second wait without invoking any character animation. Empty SD visuals therefore preserve startup scheduling while publishing no character sprites.

PlayLiveStartVoice reaches PlayVoice only after a usable voice model, dictionary entry and selected cue; missing data takes the no-resource return path. isPlayingLiveStartVoice returns false when its SoundResource field is null. This reaffirms SD13 and authorizes a permanently null portable live-start voice input.

For a host that can never provide character or live-start-voice assets, the fail-closed public shape uses literal null for both fields. SD-character null maps only to a frozen allocated empty collection; voice null maps only to the original missing SoundResource path. The stage backdrop remains mandatory, stage/character timing remains unchanged, and no transparent placeholder, default character, silent audio, inferred identity or no-op fallback is introduced.

supersession.disposition: superseded only for GarupaEditor hosts that cannot provide SD-character or live-start-voice assets; common prefab, stage backdrop, information resources and timing remain unchanged
